title: Siman 260
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.he: פַּעַם אַחַתסִפֵּר רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה לְפָנַי בְּדֶרֶךְ קֻבְלָנָא
segments.en: (20.) He said a parable: Once a great merchant was traveling with fine Hungarian wine. Once the servant and the wagon driver said to the master of the house: "We are traveling on this road with this wine and bearing all this discomfort — let us taste a little." And he gave them a little of that fine wine to taste. Some days later it came about that this servant was gathered together with some wine drinkers in a small city and they were drinking wine and praising it greatly, saying it was Hungarian wine. The aforementioned servant said: "Let me taste it" — and they gave him some. And he said: "I know this is not good Hungarian wine at all" — and they scolded him and pushed him away. And he said: "I truly know this is not Hungarian wine at all — for I was with a great merchant..."
